narrative.overview:
COMPTE is a working desk for quotes, invoices, and cash, not a marketing page. The screen stays dense and quiet so a tenant admin can scan what needs action. White surfaces sit on a cool canvas. The only brand colors are the two colors in the COMPTE mark: the globe and the wordmark.

The mark itself is the logo. Use public/logo.svg for the full lockup and the cropped globe in src/app/icon.svg for the favicon. Do not redraw the wordmark as live text beside a letter tile.

Large brand areas, including the priority hero and the assistant card, are filled with wordmark navy. Globe blue is reserved for the thing the user can do or the place they are: primary buttons, links, the active navigation item, and selected filters. Money state uses its own green, amber, red, and violet, and those colors never stand in for the brand.
keyCharacteristics: Two brand colors taken from the logo, plus a cool neutral canvas.
Compact controls, hairline borders, and soft resting shadows.
Status color means document or payment state, not decoration.
Sidebar plus sticky header, with the full logo in the sidebar and a smaller lockup in the mobile header.
Motion is short and physical: a slight lift on hover, and no motion when the user prefers reduced motion.

rules.name: The Logo Pair Rule
rules.body: Globe blue and wordmark navy are the only brand colors. Do not introduce a third brand blue.

rules.name: The Action Rule
rules.body: Globe blue marks an action, a link, or the current place. Wordmark navy carries text and large brand fields. Do not fill a whole content region with globe blue.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Do not add a second type family for marketing emphasis inside the workspace.

rules.name: The Desk Rule
rules.body: Keep the sidebar, the sticky header, and one scrolling work column. Do not turn the workspace into a centered marketing column.

rules.name: The Rest Then Lift Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are quiet at rest. A stronger shadow is a response to hover or to the single hero, not a default on every box.

rules.name: The Shared Corner Rule
rules.body: A control the user can press uses the 10px radius. Do not mix pill buttons into the desk.

dos: Do take brand color from the logo: globe blue (`{colors.globe}`) for action and selection, wordmark navy (`{colors.wordmark}`) for text and large brand fills.
Do keep status green, amber, red, and violet tied to document or payment state.
Do use the 10px control radius, the 15px card radius, and the resting-card shadow for new working surfaces.
Do put the full `logo.svg` lockup in the sidebar and the smaller lockup in the mobile header.
Do honor reduced motion by dropping the lift, the entrance blur, and the spinner orbit.
donts: Don't reintroduce the previous periwinkle (`#315ce9`) or a letter-tile wordmark.
Don't fill large content regions with globe blue.
Don't use status red or green as a brand accent.
Don't add a second type family or a loaded display face inside the workspace.
Don't turn operational screens into a centered marketing layout.
